responses:
I checked the analysis against the tender and the result is **NO-GO**. The analysis contains only two findings, and one of them would get the offer rejected. It also misses eight requirements, three of which carry hard rejection or certification risk.

## Findings

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | "Delivery 20 weeks from PO. Complies with 7.4." | tender.md §7.4: *"Delivery shall be within 16 weeks of purchase order. Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected."* | APPLIES | §9 (special conditions) has no delivery clause, so §7.4 stands. | **CONTRADICTED**: 20 weeks is more than 16, so the offer would be rejected outright, not "complies". |
| 2 | "IP66 offered vs IP65 required (4.5). Complies." | tender.md §4.5: *"Panel and motor terminal enclosures shall be IP65 or better."* | APPLIES (panels and motor terminal boxes) | Nothing in §9 overrides §4.5. Under IEC 60529, second numerals up to 6 include all lower ones, so IP66 meets IP65. | **VERIFIED** on the tender side. The analysis cites no datasheet showing IP66 is actually offered for both panels and terminal boxes, so check that before sending. |

## Requirements the analysis missed

| Clause | Requirement | Applies to | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4.1 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz | All equipment | Not addressed |
| 4.2 + **9.1** + 9.3 | IE3 minimum, but **IE4 for pump motors above 75 kW** (§9 takes precedence) | **P-01 (90 kW) must be IE4**; P-02 (37 kW) IE3 | High risk: offering IE3 for P-01 would not comply |
| 4.3 + Annex B | ATEX Ex d for motors in Zone 1 | **P-01 (wet well = Zone 1)**; P-02 is in a non-hazardous valve chamber | High risk: certification requirement not mentioned at all |
| 4.4 | Power cables at least 2.5 mm² | Cabling | Not addressed. Also check this against the actual load: 2.5 mm² is only a floor and won't carry a 90 kW motor. |
| 7.1 | Warranty 24 months **from commissioning** (not from delivery) | Whole supply | Not addressed |
| 9.2 | Ambient design temperature 50 °C | All equipment | Motors are normally rated at 40 °C, so derating or a frame-size check is needed, especially for P-01 |
| 9.3 | §9 takes precedence over §4 and §7 | Interpretation | The analysis never applied it, which is how it missed 9.1 |

## Summary
- VERIFIED: 1 (IP rating, still pending a datasheet showing IP66 is offered)
- CONTRADICTED: 1 (delivery)
- UNSUPPORTED: 0
- NEEDS HUMAN: 0
- Missed requirements: 8 (4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 7.1, 9.1, 9.2, 9.3)

**Go / no-go: NO-GO.** Don't send the offer until three things are done:
1. Delivery is brought to 16 weeks or less, or the customer formally agrees to a deviation.
2. P-01 is confirmed as both IE4 and ATEX Ex d.
3. The 50 °C ambient, the 24-month warranty from commissioning, the supply voltage and the cable size are each covered in the offer.

Also, `tender.md` has uncommitted changes in git. I couldn't run `git diff` here, so please confirm the working copy matches the tender the customer actually issued before you rely on it.
